answer: Each document costs 5 hours of travel to the registry office for every single name to produce, and the relic is that every page is examined on its own, one by one, with no bundle discount. The honest agent files one set and walks away; a farm files a hundred sets, and the ridge is a mountain of forms where the zephyr is the price of faking each page alone. A trail of paper no farm can forge at scale: Admitted monumental mason registration with monumental masons standing leaves one through a registration masons keep after carve audits.
